name: Alcaucín (Spain)
description: Horizontally divided red over green, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Alcaucín (a castle on red above a bridge on green).
history: Municipal flag of Alcaucín; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Alcaucín arms — castle on red above a bridge on green
